column1: # Accepted CodeQL findings. The gate in production-checks.yml ignores exactly
# these, and nothing else. Changing this file takes a pull request.

column3: CSRF is handled without tokens: every non-GET /api request passes requireSameOrigin (Origin/Referer must equal this host; a browser always sends Origin on cross-origin POST/PUT), the session cookie is SameSite=Lax, and state-changing endpoints only accept JSON bodies (cross-site JSON needs a CORS preflight, which is never granted). CodeQL does not recognise the Origin check. Tested in test/api.test.ts (requireSameOrigin) and test/settingsRoutes.test.ts (cross-site PUT settings, POST reboot, PUT preferences all get 403 and reach nothing).

The one file where cams skips chain validation (test/noUnverifiedTls.test.ts fails on rejectUnauthorized other than true anywhere else in server/), for exactly three uses (cam-proxy spec 2026-10-05 §10.1.4, §12.3): (1) connectPinned/pinnedConnection, a camera on the leaf-pin fallback (self-signed factory certificate): the SHA-256 of the leaf is compared with the pin at secureConnect, before any request byte is written, and the socket destroyed on a mismatch (Node skips checkServerIdentity when the chain fails); tested in test/leafPin.test.ts ("refuses any other certificate before a single byte is sent": zero bytes reach the server) and test/cameraTls.test.ts; (2) CA_FETCH_CONNECT, GET /tls/ca.pem from a pinned cam-proxy: the certificate is signed by the CA being fetched, the PEM's fingerprint against the pin is the check, no token is sent (test/siteCa.test.ts, test/proxyTls.test.ts "never sends the token past a wrong pin"); (3) LEGACY_UNVERIFIED_CAMERA, an https camera without tlsServername and without a pinned proxy, unverified exactly as before P5 (it was rejectUnauthorized: Boolean(tlsServername)), with a startup warning.
